notes.title: Playtest Update: BLADE MATERIALS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178535/bba1d6991703f097560f270e1a3702fe05dc837f.png[/img]

From now on, [b]all materials[/b] are available for use on the blade 🥳

To have you not go insane with the grown number of blade materials, we've slightly improved the way in which you select the blade material by splitting it into forward and back buttons. At some point in the future, we are going make blade material assignment work the same way as part material assignment 💅

tags.feature: From now on, [b]all materials[/b] are available for use on the blade 🥳

[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Update 1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The library gets a bunch of NEW SWORD PARTS (pommels, grips and caps) for you to explore!
[*] We'll add first ASIAN WRAPS that can be wrapped around straight grips as separate parts!
[*] We have heard your call and started working on BLADE MATERIALS! It's a basic first shot, but we hope you'll like it.
[*] We added some extra CONNECTORS to some existing guards. Have a look!
[*] If a part has attachments (e.g. a part with runes or a centerpiece with tendrils) you can now scale only this part by holding ALT.
[/list]
